name: Restaurants and cafés
summary: Tip reporting, sales tax, food-cost tracking and payroll for places that run on thin margins.
body: We keep the books for about twenty restaurants, cafés and food trucks in Merrow Bend and the river towns. The monthly close includes food and labor cost as a share of sales, because those are the two numbers owners check first.
typical: Monthly books with food and labor cost|Payroll with tip reporting|Sales tax filings|S corporation return

name: Trades and contractors
summary: Job costing, equipment depreciation, subcontractor 1099s and the paperwork behind a bonding line.
body: Electricians, plumbers, roofers and general contractors: we set up job costing so each job shows its margin, track equipment for depreciation, collect W-9s from subcontractors and prepare the financial statements a surety asks for.
typical: Job-cost bookkeeping|Subcontractor 1099s|Equipment depreciation|Statements for bonding and loans

name: Medical and dental practices
summary: Practice books, partner compensation, retirement plans and the purchase or sale of a practice.
body: Physicians, dentists, physical therapists and veterinarians who own their practice. We handle the books and returns, model partner pay, and work through buying into or selling a practice.
typical: Practice bookkeeping|Partner compensation models|Retirement plan contributions|Practice purchase and sale

name: Nonprofits
summary: 990s, restricted funds, audit preparation and board reports written for volunteers.
body: Food pantries, arts groups, youth leagues, land trusts and churches. Most are run by a small staff and a volunteer board, so reports are written for people who are not accountants.
typical: Form 990 or 990-EZ|Restricted fund tracking|Audit preparation|Board treasurer reports

name: Landlords and rental owners
summary: Rental schedules, depreciation, repairs versus improvements, and the year a property is sold.
body: Owners of one to forty rental units. We keep each property separate, track depreciation from the purchase, and plan ahead for the sale.
typical: Rental property schedules|Depreciation tracking|Property sale planning|Bookkeeping by property

name: Households and retirees
summary: Individual returns, estimates, retirement distributions and the paperwork after a death in the family.
body: About 1,100 families file with us each year: wage earners, retirees, people with a side business, and executors handling a parent's estate.
typical: Individual returns|Quarterly estimates|Retirement distribution planning|Estate and trust returns
